ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "goodbye"? (1 mark)
   A. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   B. مَرْحَبًا
   C. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ
   D. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ

2. What does the Arabic word أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am well
   B. I
   C. goodbye
   D. good evening

3. Which sentence means 'I have a brother and a sister'? (1 mark)
   A. haadhaa abii
   B. ʿindii akh wa ukht
   C. man haadhihi?
   D. ummii tatbukhu

4. What does the Arabic word بِنْتٌ (bint) mean? (1 mark)
   A. son
   B. daughter
   C. father's sister
   D. mother's brother

5. What does the Arabic word فِي (fii) mean? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. above
   C. under
   D. in

6. What does the Arabic word فَوْقَ (fawqa) mean? (1 mark)
   A. beside
   B. above
   C. under
   D. at (near, by)

7. What does the Arabic sentence أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I play on Saturday.
   B. Today is Thursday.
   C. There are seven days in a week.
   D. I go to school on Monday.

8. How is the Arabic word اِسْمَعْ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ijlis
   B. aghmiD ʿaynayka
   C. ismaʿ
   D. ukhruj

9. What does the Arabic word الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. today
   C. Monday
   D. day

10. What does the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) mean? (1 mark)
   A. raise your hand
   B. stand up
   C. go out
   D. open the door

11. Which word do you say to tell a friend it is now their turn? (1 mark)
   A. shukran
   B. dawruka
   C. dawrii
   D. laa

12. How is the Arabic word كَعْكَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿasiir
   B. dawruka
   C. kaʿka
   D. taʿaam

13. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like bananas.
   B. I eat bread.
   C. I like juice.
   D. I drink water.

14. What does the Arabic word مَاءٌ (maa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. chicken
   B. maize
   C. water
   D. sugar

15. What does the Arabic word جِسْمٌ (jism) mean? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. body
   C. neck
   D. back

16. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I speak with my mouth.
   B. I hear with my ear.
   C. I smell with my nose.
   D. I see with my eye.

17. What does the Arabic word مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. rainy
   B. weather
   C. cloudy
   D. sun

18. What happens to the voice at the end of a statement? (1 mark)
   A. It rises
   B. It falls
   C. It stops
   D. It shouts

19. What can help a nervous speaker? (1 mark)
   A. Speaking very quickly
   B. Practising many times before speaking
   C. Not preparing at all
   D. Whispering

20. In a short speech, what does the sentence anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am in Grade 4
   B. I am at the door
   C. I am a teacher
   D. I am in the kitchen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Say what the words abii yaʿmalu and ummii tatbukhu mean, and name one thing each parent does. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Translate into English: al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila (2 marks)

23. Explain the difference between kayfa haaluka? and kayfa haaluki? (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: kayfa haaluki? (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila (2 marks)

26. Translate into English: abii yaʿmalu (2 marks)

27. Write the seven days of the week in Arabic sounds, in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

28. Introduce yourself in Arabic (English letters are fine) with your name, that you are a pupil and that you are from Kenya, then give the English meaning. (4 marks) (4 marks)

29. Translate into English: ʿiid mubaarak (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba (2 marks)

31. Explain the difference between a direct question and an inferential question. Give one example of each about a text on breakfast. (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

2. A — I am well
   أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

3. B — ʿindii akh wa ukht
   ʿindii means 'I have', akh is brother, wa is 'and' and ukht is sister.

4. B — daughter
   بِنْتٌ (bint) means daughter.

5. D — in
   فِي (fii) means in.

6. B — above
   فَوْقَ (fawqa) means above.

7. D — I go to school on Monday.
   أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

8. C — ismaʿ
   اِسْمَعْ is read ismaʿ and means listen.

9. B — today
   الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) means today.

10. C — go out
   اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) means go out.

11. B — dawruka
   dawruka means 'your turn'. dawrii means 'my turn'.

12. C — kaʿka
   كَعْكَةٌ is read kaʿka and means cake.

13. C — I like juice.
   أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ (uhibbu l-ʿasiira) means: I like juice.

14. C — water
   مَاءٌ (maa') means water.

15. B — body
   جِسْمٌ (jism) means body.

16. D — I see with my eye.
   أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

17. A — rainy
   مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) means rainy.

18. B — It falls
   In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises.

19. B — Practising many times before speaking
   Practice makes a speaker calm and confident.

20. A — I am in Grade 4
   Saff means class and raabiʿ means fourth.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: abii yaʿmalu: My father works. ummii tatbukhu: My mother cooks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each translation and 1 mark for each role named.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: kayfa haaluka? is said to a boy or man. kayfa haaluki? is said to a girl or woman. Both mean 'How are you?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy and girl endings and 1 mark for the meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: How are you? (to a girl)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: The book is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: My father works.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven in order; 3 for five or six; 2 for three or four; 1 for one or two.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: ismii Wanjiku. anaa tilmiidha. anaa min Kiiniya. My name is Wanjiku. I am a pupil. I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: The pen is in the bag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

31. (4 marks)
   Answer: A direct question has its answer in the text, for example 'What does she drink?' An inferential question needs clues, for example 'Is it morning?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each definition and 1 mark for each suitable example.
